dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned markings are visible against the dark pelt. The most prominent structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast outer perimeters that transition sharply from the dark exterior to light-grey/tan outlines, enclosing centers of lower intensity than the rings themselves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of discrete, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters located primarily on the anterior-dorsal flank. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack internal gradients, appearing as scattered speckles among the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral across the mid-dorsal surface, characterized by uneven internal angles and varying relative distances between the anterior and posterior pairs.
